defs.def: a particular attitude towards sth; a way of thinking about sth 态度；观点；思考方法

ex.s: This aspect of storytelling-presenting a different perspective of the world—is important when it comes to connecting with each other.
ex.t: 讲故事的这一面——呈现对世界的不同视角——在彼此建立联系时很重要。

ex.s: It also helps them to gain a global perspective.
ex.t: 这也有助于他们获得全球视野。

ex.s: These biased perspectives cannot be blamed on one single cause.
ex.t: 这些有偏见的观点不能归因于任何一个单一原因。

defs.def: the ability to think about problems and decisions in a reasonable way without exaggerating their importance 客观判断力；权衡轻重的能力

ex.s: Studying abroad also helps you to gain a global perspective and improve your general competence.
ex.t: 出国留学也有助于你开拓全球视野，并提升整体能力。

ex.s: Therefore, China needs more talented young people with a global perspective who are highly competent with languages, have leadership and organisational skills, and have strong cultural awareness.
ex.t: 因此，中国需要更多有才华的年轻人，他们具有全球视野，语言能力强，有领导力和组织能力，以及强烈的文化意识。

defs.def: the art of creating an effect of depth and distance in a picture by representing people and things that are far away as being smaller than those that are nearer the front 透视法

ex.s: We could also say When I finish it, I feel the book has given me a wider picture of the world and makes me able to see things from a different perspective.
ex.t: 我们也可以说：当我读完它的时候，我觉得这本书给了我一个更广阔的世界图景，让我能够从不同的视角看问题。

defs.def: a view, especially one in which you can see far into the distance 景观；远景

ex.s: These expansions into new worlds help us by giving us new perspectives.
ex.t: 这些向新领域的拓展帮助我们获得新的视角。

ex.s: Art can make us see ourselves clearly, it can also help us see the world from a new perspective.
ex.t: 艺术可以让我们清楚地看到自己，也可以帮助我们从一个新的角度看待世界。
